lines.en: label mall15:
scene mall1
I show up at the mall around the same time I always do and immediately take note of Chika not being on what I will now just refer to as {i}our{/i} bench.
lines.zh: 我照例在同一时间来到商场，立刻注意到 Chika 不在那张我现在干脆称之为{i}我们{/i}的长椅上。

lines.en: Being an adult who's able to pick up on context clues, I understand that her absence means she’s working right now and I begin to ponder over whether or not today is the day I have been waiting for.
lines.zh: 作为一个能读懂情境线索的成年人，我明白她的缺席意味着她正在上班，于是我开始琢磨，今天是不是我一直在等的那一天。

lines.en: It's been a while since Chika has modeled anything for me and we've definitely grown closer since then. So either we're at the lingerie stage {i}now{/i} or we will be soon.
lines.zh: Chika 已经有一阵子没给我当模特了，而我们无疑比那时亲近多了。所以要么{i}现在{/i}就到了内衣阶段，要么很快就会到。

lines.en: Either way, I must do my duty and find out.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我必须尽我的职责，去查个明白。

lines.en: scene black
scene whyissheadog1
: Chika, are you around? I was thinking that today we-
lines.zh: : Chika，你在吗？我在想今天我们要不-

lines.en: scene whyissheadog2
: Okay, nevermind. I’ll come back later.
lines.zh: : 好吧，算了。我待会儿再来。

lines.en: scene black
Not knowing how to handle the situation I have somehow found myself in, I immediately turn around and head for the door.
lines.zh: 不知道该怎么处理自己莫名其妙陷入的处境，我立刻转身朝门口走去。

lines.en: Of course, the small hand of the strange...helmeted figure reaches out and grabs my wrist.
lines.zh: 当然，那个奇怪的……戴头盔的小家伙伸出小手抓住了我的手腕。

lines.en: Her grip obviously isn’t strong enough to prevent me from leaving since she is only a fraction of my size...but I’m pretty sure I know who this is anyway and that there isn't any {i}real{/i} reason to run.
lines.zh: 她的力气显然不足以阻止我离开，因为她只有我身形的几分之一……不过我大概已经知道她是谁了，而且也没有什么{i}真正{/i}的理由要跑。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog2
: Woof!
: Hello, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 你好，Chinami。

lines.en: : Woof!
: Would you mind explaining to me why you’re dressed like that? And...out in public?
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下你为什么穿成这样吗？而且……还穿到公共场合来？

lines.en: : Big sis made Chinami put on her special mall clothes so she could be safe at work!
lines.zh: : 姐姐让 Chinami 穿上她的专用商场服，这样她上班的时候就能安全啦！

lines.en: : You’re not...covering your sister’s shift, are you? Because I don't think you're old enough to work here.
lines.zh: : 你不是在……替你姐姐代班吧？因为我觉得你还不到能在这儿工作的年纪。

lines.en: : Chinami is a 5,000 year old wizard! She is more than old enough to work!
lines.zh: : Chinami 是个 5000 岁的巫师！她的年纪绝对够上班了！

lines.en: : But no! Chinami didn’t want to be alone today and big-sis Yumi couldn’t come over.
lines.zh: : 不过不是！Chinami 今天不想一个人待着，而 Yumi 姐姐又过不来。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re probably better off without Yumi anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊，没有 Yumi 在身边，你大概反而更好。

lines.en: : Woof!
: Chinami, would you mind telling me where your sister is?
lines.zh: : Chinami，能告诉我你姐姐在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : I’m coming! Hold on one sec!
lines.zh: : 我来了！稍等一下！

lines.en: This stare-down is making me incredibly uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 这种对视让我极度不自在。

lines.en: : Chinami, go be a good girl and go...organize the underwear or something.
lines.zh: : Chinami，乖，去……整理一下内衣什么的。

lines.en: : Okay! But Chinami needs to be sure she'll be fairly compensated!
lines.zh: : 好的！但 Chinami 得确认自己会得到公平的报酬！

lines.en: scene whyissheadog1
What exactly would be {i}fair{/i} compensation for child labor?...
lines.zh: 对童工来说，{i}公平{/i}的报酬到底是什么？……

lines.en: scene whyissheadog3
: That kid, I swear.
lines.zh: : 那孩子，真是的。

lines.en: : She’s not a kid. She’s an ancient wizard. Be careful.
lines.zh: : 她不是孩子。她是个远古巫师。小心点。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog4
: Right, right. My bad.
lines.zh: : 对，对。我的错。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog5
: So, whatcha up to today, Sensei? Come to spend some time with your favorite student?
lines.zh: : 那么，你今天来干嘛，Sensei？来找你最喜欢的学生共度时光？

lines.en: : It certainly appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实是这样。

lines.en: : Well, sorry to break your heart, but I’m kinda slammed right now. I’ve even resorted to having Chinami help since I can't handle all of this on my own.
lines.zh: : 好吧，抱歉要伤你的心了，但我现在忙得要死。我甚至都沦落到让 Chinami 来帮忙了，因为我一个人搞不定这些。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that's against the law, but whatever.
lines.zh: : 我很确定那是违法的，不过随你吧。

lines.en: : I mean, it at least got her out of my hair for a little while...but you're right. I should probably figure something else out instead.
lines.zh: : 我是说，至少她总算不缠着我了……不过你说得对。我大概该想点别的办法。

lines.en: : It's just kinda hard since I can't really afford a-
lines.zh: : 只是有点难办，因为我实在请不起一个-

lines.en: scene whyissheadog6
: Wait a second...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Please, no.
lines.zh: : 别，求你了。

lines.en: : I just got like, a totally awesome idea.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚想到了一个超棒的主意。

lines.en: : No you didn't.
lines.zh: : 不，你没有。

lines.en: : Do you think that maybe {i}you{/i} could watch her?
lines.zh: : 你觉得……{i}你{/i}能不能帮我看着她？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog7
: Pleeeeeeease, Sensei? I’ll make it up to youuuuu~
lines.zh: : 求————求你了嘛，Sensei？我一定会报答你的~~~~

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么报答？

lines.en: : I don't know. Is there anything you want? What if I like, buy you lunch or something?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你有什么想要的吗？比如我请你吃午饭什么的？

lines.en: : I demand an expedited lingerie modeling session.
lines.zh: : 我要求提前举行内衣模特环节。

lines.en: : You’re still going on about that? That was like, forever ago.
lines.zh: : 你还在纠结那件事啊？那都是多久以前的事了。

lines.en: : There are some promises you can’t back down from, Chika.
lines.zh: : 有些承诺是不能反悔的，Chika。

lines.en: : This is a weird time to start dropping inspirational quotes.
lines.zh: : 这种时候开始掉励志名言，怪得很。

lines.en: : It's also a weird time for me to become a babysitter.
lines.zh: : 我变成保姆这件事，也怪得很。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog8
: How about this! Either you watch my sister or I call security and tell them some old guy is harassing me.
lines.zh: : 这样吧！要么你帮我看着妹妹，要么我叫保安，说有个老男人骚扰我。

lines.en: : This is blackmail.
lines.zh: : 这是勒索。

lines.en: : I guess maybe it is a little, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概，是有一点吧。

lines.en: : You’ve been hanging out with Yumi too much.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Yumi 混太久了。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog9
: Kinda unavoidable when we sleep in the same room.
lines.zh: : 我们睡同一间房，这也难免。

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll do it. You’re going to have to explain the dog thing, though.
lines.zh: : 行。我答应你。不过你得解释一下那身狗是怎么回事。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog8
: I’m sure it’s not far off from whatever you're thinking.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，跟你想的差不了多少。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t like wearing face-masks because they make her look funny. But, for some reason, she’s totally cool with a giant dog helmet.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不喜欢戴口罩，因为那会让她看起来很滑稽。但不知为什么，她对戴一个巨大的狗头盔完全没意见。

lines.en: : And she has to wear gloves to prevent herself from touching anything with germs. And the scarf thingy-
lines.zh: : 而且她必须戴手套，免得碰到有细菌的东西。还有那条围巾什么的-

lines.en: scene whyissheadog3
: Well...that I don’t really have an answer for. I think she just likes it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个我真答不上来。我觉得她就是喜欢。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog9
: She’s still super cute, though, right? And the way she’s all like “woof!” Oh my god. I wanna die.
lines.zh: : 不过她还是超级可爱，对吧？还有她那样「汪！」的样子。天哪。我想死。

lines.en: : You might want to keep an eye on her in case she walks up to any other customers, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你最好盯着她一点，免得她跑去搭讪其他客人。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog6
: Who, Chinami? She wouldn’t do something like that. She never talks to strangers.
lines.zh: : 谁，Chinami？她不会做那种事的。她从来不跟陌生人说话。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : Mhm. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 嗯。为什么这么问？

lines.en: : Because she’s trying to pet a customer’s dog right now.
lines.zh: : 因为她现在正试图摸一位客人的狗。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog10
: What?! Chinami! Stop that right now!
lines.zh: : 什么？！Chinami！马上停下！

lines.en: : Just because you're in dog form doesn't mean you can play with...{i}other{/i} dogs!
lines.zh: : 就算你变成了狗的样子，也不代表你可以跟……{i}别的{/i}狗玩！

lines.en: scene black
Chika runs over and snatches her sister away right before she comes into contact with a small dog hanging out of a wealthy-looking woman’s purse.
lines.zh: Chika 跑过去一把把妹妹拽了回来，就在她快要碰到一位阔太太包里探出头的小狗之前。

lines.en: Feeling the need to get her out of here in order to avoid any other possible issues, Chika pawns Chinami off on me and sends the two of us out to go...walk around the mall or something.
lines.zh: 觉得有必要把她带离这里、免得再出别的状况，Chika 把 Chinami 塞给我，打发我们俩出去……在商场里随便逛逛什么的。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog11
: What has my life become?
lines.zh: : 我的人生到底变成什么样了？

lines.en: : Woof!
Chinami’s tiny hands wrap around mine as the two of us walk through the mall.
lines.zh: Chinami 的小手攥住我的手，我们俩一起穿过商场。

lines.en: I’m sure everyone around thinks she’s my daughter-
lines.zh: 我敢肯定周围的人都以为她是我女儿-

lines.en: Or...at least, I {i}hope{/i} everyone around thinks she’s my daughter. It would be extremely problematic for them to think anything else at this point.
lines.zh: 或者……至少，我{i}希望{/i}周围的人以为她是我女儿。到了这个时候，他们要是往别处想，麻烦就大了。

lines.en: I'm sure the dog mask isn’t doing us any favors, either.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定那张狗面具也没帮上什么忙。

lines.en: : Are you going to be Chinami’s new daddy?
lines.zh: : 你要当 Chinami 的新爸爸吗？

lines.en: scene whyissheadog12
: No.
: Why not? You and my big sister are in love, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你和我姐姐不是相爱吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : You’re not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : No, Chinami. I’m just her teacher.
lines.zh: : 不是，Chinami。我只是她的老师。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know much about teachers since Chinami is home-schooled. Do all teachers visit you at work?
lines.zh: : Chinami 不太懂老师是什么，因为 Chinami 是在家上学的。所有老师都会去上班的地方看你吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : Then why are you visiting Big Sis? Do you need to buy new clothes?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么来看姐姐？你需要买新衣服吗？

lines.en: : You look like you need to buy new clothes.
lines.zh: : 你看起来确实需要买新衣服。

lines.en: : I...Yeah, sure. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 我……是啊，行吧。就这么说吧。

lines.en: : Do you have lots of money?
lines.zh: : 你有很多钱吗？

lines.en: : I have an adequate amount of money.
lines.zh: : 我的钱够用。

lines.en: : Will you buy Chinami a cell phone?
lines.zh: : 你会给 Chinami 买手机吗？

lines.en: : What are you going to do with a cell phone, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你要手机做什么，Chinami？

lines.en: : Chinami likes the game where you shoot birds at pigs and make them blow up.
lines.zh: : Chinami 喜欢那个把鸟射向猪、让它们爆炸的游戏。

lines.en: : Then, no. I'm not going to buy Chinami a phone.
lines.zh: : 那不行。我不会给 Chinami 买手机。

lines.en: : Do you actually hate Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你真的讨厌 Chinami 吗？

lines.en: : No. I just don’t think your sister would be happy if I bought you a phone.
lines.zh: : 不。我只是觉得你姐姐不会高兴我给你买手机。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog13
: Why not? Are cell phones expensive?
lines.zh: : 为什么？手机很贵吗？

lines.en: : Chinami has 500 yen at home that she found at the beach.
lines.zh: : Chinami 家里有在海边捡到的 500 日元。

lines.en: : That’s nowhere near enough.
lines.zh: : 那远远不够。

lines.en: : Okay. Chinami will save up more.
lines.zh: : 好吧。Chinami 会多攒一点。

lines.en: : Thank you for telling her.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你告诉她。

lines.en: : Can Chinami ask you a question?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能问你一个问题吗？

lines.en: : What is it, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 什么问题，Chinami？

lines.en: : Where do babies come from?
lines.zh: : 宝宝是从哪里来的？

lines.en: : Ask something else, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 换一个问题吧，Chinami。

lines.en: : Okay. Chinami has another question anyway.
lines.zh: : 好吧。Chinami 反正还有个问题。

lines.en: : What is it this-
lines.zh: : 这次是什么-

lines.en: scene whyissheadog13r
: Where do people go when they die?
lines.zh: : 人死了之后会去哪儿？

lines.en: scene whyissheadog12
: How about I just ask you some questions instead?
lines.zh: : 要不换成我问你几个问题吧？

lines.en: : Okay! Chinami thinks that sounds fun.
lines.zh: : 好呀！Chinami 觉得听起来很有意思。

lines.en: I can’t see through the dog helmet, but I can tell that there is a demon inside.
lines.zh: 我看不透那个狗头盔，但我能感觉到里面住着一只恶魔。

lines.en: : Are...dogs your favorite animal, Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami 最喜欢的动物是……狗吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Chinami wants a dog but she’s not allowed to have one cause dogs can get people sick.
lines.zh: : 是的！Chinami 想要一只狗，但不能养，因为狗会让人生病。

lines.en: : Can they? I thought that was just a myth.
lines.zh: : 会吗？我以为那只是个谣言。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn't know because she is home-schooled. She just believes whatever her big sisters tell her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道，因为她是在家上学的。姐姐说什么她就信什么。

lines.en: : But if you want to teach Chinami all about animals, she’ll pay close attention.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你想教 Chinami 关于动物的一切，她会非常认真听的。

lines.en: : She is currently very interested in giraffes!
lines.zh: : 她现在对长颈鹿特别感兴趣！

lines.en: : I can barely even teach my students math. I don’t really think I’m qualified to teach you about what diseases animals carry.
lines.zh: : 我连学生的数学都教不好。我觉得我没资格教你动物携带什么疾病。

lines.en: : You can teach Chinami math, then! And you can teach big-sis Yumi, too!
lines.zh: : 那你就教 Chinami 数学吧！你也可以教 Yumi 姐姐！

lines.en: : I’d love to if she would actually show up to class every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 只要她肯偶尔来上一次课，我很乐意教。

lines.en: : Oh. Chinami forgot Yumi goes to[school] again.
lines.zh: : 哦。Chinami 忘了 Yumi 又去[school]了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Chinami. I forget that too sometimes.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Chinami。我有时也会忘。

lines.en: : Can Chinami ask another question?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能再问个问题吗？

lines.en: : That depends. Is it going to be something else incredibly difficult to answer given the nature of our relationship?
lines.zh: : 看情况。鉴于我们的关系，会不会又是那种极难回答的问题？

lines.en: : Woof!
: What’s your question, Chinami?
lines.zh: : 什么问题，Chinami？

lines.en: : Who are the girls in front of us?
lines.zh: : 我们前面那些女孩是谁？

lines.en: : Girls? What g-
lines.zh: : 女孩？什么女-

lines.en: scene whyissheadog14
: I can explain.
lines.zh: : 我可以解释。

lines.en: : Um...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : Woof!
: This is a dog.
lines.zh: : 这是一只狗。

lines.en: : Woof!
: Oh. Okay. Yes. That makes perfect sense.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。是的。这完全说得通。

lines.en: : Sensei...wants to get me a present and...is looking at dogs...
lines.zh: : Sensei……想给我买礼物……正在看狗……

lines.en: : That's-
lines.zh: : 那是-

lines.en: : It is clearly a dog, Maya. Just look at it.
lines.zh: : 这明显是只狗，Maya。你看看它。

lines.en: : Nothing to see here.
lines.zh: : 这儿没什么好看的。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog14r
: What the actual fuck?...
lines.zh: : 到底什么鬼？……

lines.en: : Let’s go, Maya. Staying here and getting to know the dog will spoil the surprise.
lines.zh: : 走了，Maya。留在这儿跟狗混熟会破坏惊喜的。

lines.en: : That’s a good idea. Hurry along, Ami. Forget what you saw here.
lines.zh: : 这主意不错。快走吧，Ami。忘了你在这儿看到的东西。

lines.en: : I will. I'm sorry for bothering you on your day off, Sensei. I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 我会的。抱歉休息日还来打扰你，Sensei。回头见。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog15
: Do you need me to call the police?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你报警吗？

lines.en: : Maya, come on. There is a perfectly reasonable explanation for this.
lines.zh: : Maya，别这样。这事有一个完全合理的解释。

lines.en: : Woof!
: Run.
: Run as far away as you can.
lines.zh: : 能跑多远跑多远。

lines.en: scene whyissheadog16
Maya leaves, but Ami appears to be having some difficulty regaining control of her legs.
lines.zh: Maya 走了，但 Ami 似乎有点难以重新控制自己的双腿。

lines.en: : You know...the more I look at her-
lines.zh: : 你知道么……我越看她-

lines.en: : Forget what you saw here, Ami.
lines.zh: : 忘了你在这儿看到的东西，Ami。

lines.en: : Woof!
scene whyissheadog17
: My head hurts...
lines.zh: : 我头疼……

lines.en: : Okay. We’re heading back to your sister’s store now whether she likes it or not.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不管她姐姐乐不乐意，我们现在就回她店里去。

lines.en: : Chinami agrees! She feels like that could have gone better!
lines.zh: : Chinami 同意！她觉得刚才本来可以更好！

lines.en: scene black
Thankfully, by the time we get back to the boutique, Chika’s already caught up on restocking the store and is able to take Chinami back without issue.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，等我们回到精品店时，Chika 已经把补货的活儿赶完了，可以毫无问题地把 Chinami 接回去。

lines.en: Myself, on the other hand...
lines.zh: 而我呢……

lines.en: Well, it looks like I might have some explaining to do later...
lines.zh: 看来我待会儿大概有得解释了……

lines.en: $ chika_love += 1
$ mall15 = True
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
